rating_rubric.0: No reviewed public evidence for this dimension.
rating_rubric.1: Conceptual or incomplete treatment without an executable interoperability contract.
rating_rubric.2: Concrete specification, schema, flow, or project evidence, with material gaps.
rating_rubric.3: Detailed contract plus maintained implementation, test, or operational evidence.
rating_rubric.4: Detailed contract plus multiple independently maintained implementations or externally governed interoperability evidence.
rating_rubric.unknown: Evidence was insufficient to assign a score.

rating_warning: Scores are evidence-maturity assessments by dimension, not a composite quality rank, certification, adoption measure, or statement of protocol priority.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Open Participation
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Published SDK/provider and directory registration paths; same-project implementation only.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Registration success and invalid credential/rejected registration are named; open global participation has no vector.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Public registration and SDK support do not establish unrestricted global participation or independent implementation.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Heterogeneous Handlers
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Published provider adapters and both directory flavors advertise typed capabilities; same-project implementation only.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Positive effective-capability advertisement and negative invalid limit; arbitrary handler types not enumerated.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Supported adapters demonstrate heterogeneity; arbitrary handler classes are not qualified.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Control/Data Plane Separation
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Maintained SDK consumers dispatch to providers after Directory discovery; same-project implementation only.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Discovery and direct task path have named tests; no measured independence at Internet scale.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Direct payload path is specified; throughput independence is not measured here.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Bounded State
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Signed snapshot/event-tail design and directory flavors are published, but no sublinear-state implementation claim.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: No positive/negative Internet-scale bounded-state fixture located.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: No proof that any single directory has state sublinear in total registrations.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Capability Aggregation
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Directory discovery is implemented; aggregate cross-domain advertisement is not specified.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: No aggregation or withdrawal fixture equivalent to the draft requirement.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: No cross-domain aggregate advertisement contract equivalent to requirement.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Local Forwarding Decisions
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Directory recommendation and client policy run in maintained SDKs; no datagram-local forwarding implementation.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: No positive/negative local-only forwarding fixture; this is a different design.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Directory-assisted selection differs from local-only datagram forwarding.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Real-Time State Decided by Its Holder
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Provider availability reports and directory probes are implemented; both are same-project evidence.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Available/reachable versus stale/unavailable cases; holder-only real-time selection not proven.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Provider admission is local, while directory eligibility uses observations and reports with bounded freshness.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Delivery Endpoint Declared by Handler Policy
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Provider route advertisement and bounded ticket validation exist in maintained implementations.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Routable versus non-routable endpoint cases; callback-delivery alternative absent.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Advertised routes exist; draft callback-delivery alternative is not a general IICP contract.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Session-Agnostic Delivery
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: HTTP task binding and draft native binding keep task identity separate from transport.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Same logical intent over bindings is modeled; identical datagram-delivery behavior not tested.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: IICP task identity is binding-neutral but no identical datagram-delivery mechanism is specified.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Matching Based on Routable Identifiers
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Directory exact-match intent matching is implemented in both flavors.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Known exact intent versus unknown/mismatched intent; no prefix-routing vector.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: IICP opaque exact-match identifiers are not routable prefixes.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Deterministic Forwarding, No Data-Path Inference
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Maintained Directory is outside direct task-payload path; no data-path inference is required.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Direct CALL/RESPONSE and refusal cases are named; Internet-scale forwarding cost unmeasured.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Directory is not task-payload transit; no Internet-wide forwarding performance proof.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Routable Hierarchical Namespace
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Opaque project identifier architecture is documented; no prefix-aggregation implementation.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: No positive/negative prefix-matching or aggregate-state fixture.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Textual URN hierarchy does not imply aggregability or prefix matching.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Isolation and Cross-Domain Authorization
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Restricted-domain membership and local policy are pre-normative same-project fixtures.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Allowed member and denied foreign/unverified member are covered in local fixtures; no external deployment proof.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: No qualified cross-domain deployment or independent enforcement evidence.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Bounded Convergence
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Snapshot/event-tail federation exists as a design and preview implementation, not a bounded-convergence result.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: No latency-bound convergence fixture at cross-domain scale.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: No bounded cross-domain convergence result at draft scale.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Delivery Reachability
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Directory reachability and availability gates exist in maintained directories.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Eligible/current versus stale/unreachable cases; delivery to every registered handler is not guaranteed.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Registered is not necessarily available or reachable; eligible routes can fail.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Return-Path Reachability
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Supported HTTP task handlers return responses directly to callers.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Response and timeout/error paths are named; adverse-network return reachability unmeasured.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Direct request/response path exists; adverse-network scale unmeasured.

intent_routing_requirements.title: Intent Decomposed at the Originator
intent_routing_requirements.implementation_evidence: Maintained consumers submit explicit intent identifiers.
intent_routing_requirements.positive_negative_cases: Known and unknown intent handling; natural-language decomposition is application-owned and untested by IICP.
intent_routing_requirements.limitation: Application supplies intent; natural-language decomposition remains outside Core.
